entry.title: MPC File Browser 1.0.0
entry.summary: FileBrowser Quantum beside MPC: browse, upload and download the device's drives in a web browser (through an SSH tunnel by default). ## 1.0.0 The first stable release. It is the same as 0.1.1, which has been running on an MPC Key 37: - FileBrowser Quantum v2.0.1-stable, the unmodified upstream binary. It starts with MPC and stops when MPC exits, at low CPU and disk priority, with no search index by default. - It listens on `127.0.0.1:6760`: reach it through an SSH tunnel. `bind=0.0.0.0` opens it

entry.title: MPC File Browser 0.1.1 (beta)
entry.summary: FileBrowser Quantum beside MPC: browse, upload and download the device's drives in a web browser (through an SSH tunnel by default). ## Changes since 0.1.0 The installer is now the one on mpc-vst-plugins main, so it matches the catalog's template. On a device whose root is read-only (dm-verity), it can now install anyway. It also keeps `install.sh` and `mpc-plugin.json` in `/data/mpc-addins/filebrowser/`, so you can reinstall after a firmware update without the zip. The addin itself is unchanged

entry.title: MPC File Browser 0.1.0 (beta)
entry.summary: FileBrowser Quantum beside MPC: browse, upload and download the device's drives in a web browser (through an SSH tunnel by default). ## In this first release - FileBrowser Quantum v2.0.1-stable, the unmodified upstream binary, started with MPC and stopped when MPC exits, at low CPU and disk priority, with no search index by default. - Listens on `127.0.0.1:6760`: reach it through an SSH tunnel. `bind=0.0.0.0` opens it to the network. - Log in as `admin`, password `mpcadmin`.
